mappedContracts.statement: Reconcile all existing issues, pull requests, branches, tracks, decisions, and partially implemented work before creating new work items.
acceptanceCriteria: Open issues #161 through #167 are mapped and reused.
Closed issue #168 and its implementation are explicitly audited against the new mutation contracts.
Open PR #176 is assessed and either incorporated, superseded with explanation, or retained with a documented dependency.
No duplicate issue or track is created for work already represented.
requiredEvidence: Issue and PR comments documenting supersession or reuse

mappedContracts.statement: Prohibit guessed POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE endpoint discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown mutations remain planning-only or manual.
Every executable mutation references exact first-party capture evidence, method, request schema, response schema, and last verified version.
Domain, team, refund, moderation, subscriber, publication-setting, revise, and unschedule surfaces are audited.

mappedContracts.statement: Approval must be cryptographically or independently bound to the exact plan and must not be a self-generated unhashed checksum available to the planner.
acceptanceCriteria: Use HMAC with a key unavailable to the planner, a detached signature, or a separately persisted human approval record.
Approvals expire, are single-use, identify the approver, and reject drift or replay.
The old draft-mutation approval-token implementation is audited and replaced.

mappedContracts.statement: Unschedule and published revision preserve the canonical URL where required, default to no resend, reconcile before and after, and never use a schedule endpoint as an unschedule guess.
acceptanceCriteria: Exact captured endpoint and payload evidence exists.
keep-url and no-resend are plan-bound fields.
Issue #168 implementation is retained only if it satisfies the new contract; otherwise it is reverted or replaced.
